# Hook & Roost Mortgage

> Hook & Roost Mortgage (also written "Hook and Roost Mortgage") is the mortgage brokerage brand of Katie Luis (NMLS #2826935), a loan officer licensed in Washington and Massachusetts. Loans are offered through Edge Home Finance (NMLS #891464). As a broker, Katie shops each loan across many wholesale lenders rather than offering a single bank's products.

## About Katie Luis
- U.S. Army veteran and military spouse (husband is active duty Air Force); lives in Washington State.
- 20+ years in helping roles, first in healthcare, then the Army.
- Works with first-time buyers, move-up buyers, military families and homeowners refinancing.
- Licensed in Washington and Massachusetts; with her team, can help borrowers in every U.S. state except New Jersey.

## Service area
- All of Washington State, including Seattle/King County, Tacoma/Pierce County, Everett/Snohomish County, Spokane, Vancouver/Clark County, Olympia, Kitsap, Bellingham, Tri-Cities, Yakima, Wenatchee and Whidbey Island.
- All of Massachusetts, including Greater Boston, Worcester, Springfield/Pioneer Valley, Western Mass and the Berkshires, North Shore, South Shore, Cape Cod, Merrimack Valley and MetroWest.
- Works with military families near Joint Base Lewis-McChord, Fairchild AFB, Naval Base Kitsap, NAS Whidbey Island, Naval Station Everett, Hanscom AFB, Joint Base Cape Cod, Westover ARB and Barnes ANGB.

## Loan types
- First-time home buyer loans and down payment assistance guidance
- VA loans
- FHA loans
- USDA loans
- Conventional loans
- Jumbo loans
- Refinancing (rate/term and cash-out)
